evals.prompt: Write a 15-second Seedance 2.5 prompt for a UGC ad for a vitamin C serum. The creator is a woman in her 30s in her bathroom. She should mention one honest drawback. Give me 3 hook variants. Vertical 9:16 for TikTok.
evals.expected_output: A UGC mode prompt with phone-shot visual texture, natural bathroom lighting, 5-beat structure (hook, problem, demo, payoff, CTA), 3 distinct hook variants, one honest drawback in the creator performance, and a soft CTA.
expectations: The prompt names casual UGC creator-style video or phone-shot texture before describing the story action.
The prompt contains 3 distinct hook variants for the 0-2s opening, using different formula patterns (e.g., contrarian, specific number, curiosity gap).
The 5-beat structure (hook, problem, demo, payoff, CTA) is present with timestamps fitting within 15 seconds.
The creator performance direction includes conversational delivery with contractions, filler words, or casual language, and mentions one honest drawback or learning curve.
The CTA is soft — permission, not pressure — with one action and one destination.
The prompt specifies 9:16 vertical, natural window lighting, and a real-environment background.

evals.prompt: Write a 15-second Seedance prompt for a UGC unboxing ad for wireless earbuds. Show the box opening, the product reveal, and the first reaction. Three angles: overhead, 45-degree, and close-up.
evals.expected_output: A UGC unboxing prompt with three camera angles, layered reveal in beats, genuine first-reaction performance, sensory audio detail, and product visible by 0:03.
expectations: The prompt establishes UGC unboxing mode with phone-shot texture and three angles (overhead, 45-degree, close-up macro) before the action.
The reveal is structured in beats (e.g., seal break, lid lift, product emerges, first impression) rather than showing everything at once.
The product is visible by approximately 0:03 within the beat structure.
The creator performance includes genuine first-reaction cues (eyes widen, breath catch, honest reaction).
The audio direction includes sensory detail (tape peeling, cardboard, click of lid) or natural voice reactions.
The prompt includes text and logo protection directives for the product packaging.

evals.prompt: Write a 15-second Seedance prompt for a UGC how-to ad showing how to use a portable espresso maker. The creator should demonstrate the steps in a real kitchen. Include captions guidance.
evals.expected_output: A UGC how-to tutorial prompt with real-environment staging, step-by-step demonstration, conversational explainer tone, burned-in captions, and a harder CTA including brand name.
expectations: The prompt establishes UGC how-to mode with real-environment context (kitchen) before the action.
The narrative uses a problem-to-solution structure with step-by-step demonstration beats.
The creator delivery is a calm explainer tone — clear, step-by-step, confident but not corporate.
The prompt includes caption guidance (bold sans-serif, 28px+, bottom 20%, white with black stroke, synced with voiceover).
The CTA is harder than typical UGC — direct with brand name included.
The prompt specifies cutting every 2-4 seconds and product filling 50%+ of frame.

evals.prompt: Write a 6-second Seedance prompt for a product showcase of a stainless steel water bottle. Product-as-hero, no presenter, studio lighting. Use the 1-2-1 structure.
evals.expected_output: A product showcase prompt with product-as-hero framing, 1-2-1 beat structure, one camera move per beat, studio lighting directives, and text/logo protection.
expectations: The prompt establishes product showcase mode with studio-quality, product-as-hero framing before the action.
The 1-2-1 structure is present: 1 establishing shot, 2 detail/action shots, 1 brand identity shot.
Camera direction specifies one camera move per beat and caps rotation to 10-15 degrees to protect text and logos.
Lighting direction includes 45-degree hard key with soft fill for hero and raking light for macro texture.
The prompt has no presenter or voiceover — the product speaks through motion and material.
The prompt includes text and logo protection directives: rigid, sharp, undeformed.

evals.prompt: Write a 15-second Seedance prompt for a product review ad for a skincare device. The creator should use a skeptic-to-convert structure. Mention one honest con. Natural lighting, real bathroom setting.
evals.expected_output: A product review prompt with skeptic-to-convert hook, hands-on product demonstration, one honest limitation, mandatory voice, and a single soft CTA.
expectations: The prompt establishes product review mode with UGC-adjacent texture (real bathroom, natural lighting, handheld framing) before the action.
The hook uses a skeptic-to-convert formula (e.g., 'I was skeptical but...').
The product is shown in active use, not sitting on a shelf — hands-on demonstration with visible proof.
The creator performance includes one honest con or limitation alongside the wins.
The audio direction specifies voice as mandatory with natural room sound.
The CTA is a single action, single destination, soft not pushy.

evals.prompt: Write a 30-second Seedance prompt for a TV spot for a premium coffee brand. Use the PAS framework (Problem-Agitate-Solve). Brand name should appear early. Multiple emotional peaks. 16:9 broadcast quality.
evals.expected_output: A TV spot prompt with PAS narrative framework, 0-5-22-30 timing structure, broadcast-grade cinematography, multiple emotional peaks, brand cues interspersed throughout, and brand lock-in in the final 3-5 seconds.
expectations: The prompt establishes TV spot mode with broadcast-grade visual texture and 16:9 aspect ratio before the action.
The narrative uses the PAS framework (Problem-Agitate-Solve) with the 0-5-22-30 timing structure.
Brand name appears in the first 3-5 seconds and brand cues are interspersed throughout, not saved for the end.
The prompt specifies multiple emotional peaks rather than a single grand finale.
The final 3-5 seconds include brand lock-in with name, URL, or visual identity.
The product is shown in context, in use — not on a white background.

evals.prompt: Write a 15-second Seedance prompt for a UGC virtual try-on for a summer dress. The creator should show the fit, do a turn, and mention her height and size. One honest fit note. Real bedroom setting, natural light.
evals.expected_output: A UGC virtual try-on prompt with waist-level camera, real-environment setting, natural daylight, full-body multi-angle coverage with movement passes, spontaneous reactions, one honest fit note, and no color grading or logo overlays.
expectations: The prompt establishes UGC virtual try-on mode with phone-shot texture, real bedroom setting, and natural daylight before the action.
Camera direction specifies waist-level camera height, phone perpendicular to floor, and 2-2.5m distance.
The prompt includes movement passes: at least a turn and a walk to show drape and hem swing.
The creator states her height and usual size, and mentions one honest fit note (e.g., runs large, true to size).
The prompt explicitly avoids color grading, logo overlays, or consistent typography — stated as positive instructions.
The prompt includes text and label protection directives for the garment.

evals.prompt: Write a 10-second Seedance prompt for a wild card ad for a new energy drink. I want something experimental — surprise me, but make sure the visual texture is consistent throughout.
evals.expected_output: A wild card prompt with one explicitly stated dominant visual texture, one clear creative deviation from a standard mode, a defined narrative structure, and a compact mode seal.
expectations: The prompt explicitly names one dominant visual texture (e.g., UGC, studio, broadcast) rather than leaving it ambiguous.
The prompt identifies one clear creative deviation from a standard mode (e.g., reversed chronology, split-screen, match cut).
The narrative structure is defined with timestamps fitting within 10 seconds.
The mode seal reinforces the dominant texture, the creative deviation, and the audio direction.
The prompt does not mix incompatible visual textures without explaining which governs each element.

evals.prompt: Write a 20-second Seedance prompt for a Pro virtual try-on for a designer blazer. Professional model, studio lighting, editorial quality. Show the fit, a detail macro, and a movement pass.
evals.expected_output: A Pro virtual try-on prompt with studio 3-point lighting, 85mm compression lens, editorial color grade, professional model delivery, brand-forward CTA, and garment label protection — clearly distinct from UGC try-on.
expectations: The prompt establishes Pro virtual try-on mode with studio-quality, editorial visual texture before the action.
Camera direction specifies tripod or gimbal with 85-135mm equivalent lens — not handheld phone or waist-level camera.
Lighting direction specifies soft 3-point studio lighting (key softbox, fill, backlight) — not natural daylight or window light.
The prompt includes a detail macro shot (neckline, cuff, lapel, stitching, or fabric weave).
The prompt includes at least one movement pass (turn, walk, or sit) to show drape and fit in motion.
The CTA is brand-forward and aspirational, not direct-response — clearly distinct from UGC try-on's softer CTA.
